programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel feels worried when Mom hurts her arm and they need to go to the hospital. He feels better when he talks about it with Mom and she explains that the doctors and nurses will help her feel better.

programs.title: Maddie & Triggs
programs.desc: Triggs sings about one of his favourite places in the whole world - the dog park, as he and Maddie help a nervous newcomer to find her feet and reclaim her roar.

programs.title: Numberblocks
programs.desc: The Numberblocks have so many fun ideas for what to play, that it's hard to choose what to do next! Ten suggests they all vote. But what is a vote?

programs.title: Bing
programs.desc: Pando and Sula sit in the Fire Engine but when it's Bing's turn; it leaves! Flop, Amma, Sula and Bing walk to Bing's house where Arlo is stuck on the neighbour's roof! Bing must help him get down.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Join Evie Wiggle as she writes a poem! With each Wiggle asking for her help to remember something, Evie makes a helpful poem, showing that inspiration can come from anywhere!

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: A movie crew have chosen Mossy Bottom Farm as a location for a historical drama. When Mowermouth eats the film, Shaun and the gang have to step in to make sure the movie makes it to the silver screen.

programs.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programs.desc: Why do the trees lose their leaves? It does not happen in Peru. Paddington discovers autumn/fall and a winter festival.

programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.sub_title: The Tale Of Mittens' New Friend
programs.desc: When Mittens befriends Cotton-tail, their playful antics lead to trouble. Now Peter must race to save his friend and sister from the clutches of Old Brown.

programs.title: PJ Masks
programs.desc: Romeo challenges Carly and Cartoka to a race, but it's all part of a sneaky plan to steal speed crystals.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: Swoppiton Bridge is falling down, falling down - can Mojo and Bo help Nori fix a girder in time?
